# Memory

Approved beliefs for Marvin research. Proposals arrive as `[PROPOSED <LENS>]` bullets in
`_system/memory/daily/{date}.md`; `_system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py` collapses them
into `_system/reviews/pending/memory_triage.md`; a promotion pass moves approved items here
and records the decision so it never re-surfaces.

Reference library: `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/` (Munger, Pabrai, Stahl, Horizon
Kinetics, Mihaljevic/MOI). Model catalog: `_system/frameworks/mental_models.md`.

## Promotion authority

**Only the human owner promotes.** Do not edit this file during an agent session *unless the
human explicitly requests a promotion pass in that session*. When they do, every belief the
agent writes is stamped `agent` in its status tag, so an audit can separate human-approved
beliefs from agent-approved ones and reverse the latter wholesale.

**Promotion cadence:** monthly, and after any research push that generates more than ~50
proposals. Each pass: rebuild the queue, promote against the criteria below, record the
decisions in `_system/memory/triage_ledger.json`, and append a row to the pass log at the
bottom of this file.

```
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py                     # rebuild the undecided queue
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py --ingest            # record [x]/[-] ticks
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py --audit-promoted    # every `promoted` id still has a belief here
```

The ledger is **append-only**: a decided id is never overwritten, so re-ticking a
row to reverse it is refused with a warning, `--mark` exits non-zero, and nothing
changes. To re-decide, delete the id from `triage_ledger.json` and re-run with
`--previous-decision '{...}'` carrying the row you deleted — the ledger is not
tracked by git, so that field is the only record the reversal happened.

Ledger decisions are `promoted`, `rejected` and `dropped`. Use **`dropped`** when a
proposal is merged into another belief or set aside — `promoted` claims a belief
exists here, and `--audit-promoted` checks that claim, so it must not be used as a
generic "handled" marker. A promoted proposal that was reworded on the way in
carries a `memory_anchor` naming the belief that absorbed it; the anchor must
**double-quote a phrase that appears in this file verbatim**, so editing the belief
away breaks the audit. A bare path (`_system/memory/MEMORY.md`) is not an anchor —
every belief satisfies it — so `--audit-promoted` ignores it and falls back to
matching the proposal's text. Back-marking of pre-existing beliefs
(`--sync-promoted-from-memory`) is stamped `by: "backfill"`, never `agent`, so
reversing an agent's pass cannot unwind the human's earlier work.

**Promotion criteria** (all four, or it stays in the queue):

1. **Cited.** A source path that exists on disk — a filing, a wisdom PDF/extract, a framework
   doc, or the daily log that carries the reasoning. Verify the path before promoting; drop
   the bullet if you cannot.
2. **Durable.** A rule that will still be true next quarter. A dated price, a stance readout,
   a one-off run summary, or a per-ticker IRR is an observation, not a belief.
3. **Non-contradicting.** It does not conflict with an already-promoted belief. If it does,
   supersede the old one explicitly rather than letting both stand.
4. **Distinct.** Near-identical proposals are merged into one belief before promotion.

## Belief format

One bullet, one belief, ending in `— \`source/path\`` and a status tag:

| Tag | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `[active YYYY-MM-DD]` | Believed, last affirmed on that date |
| `[superseded YYYY-MM-DD]` | Replaced by newer evidence; the replacement follows as an indented line |
| `[disproven YYYY-MM-DD]` | Checked and found wrong; kept so the error is not re-learned |

Add ` · agent` to the tag when an agent, not the human, approved it. Retire a belief by
changing the tag and adding an indented line with the evidence path that retired it — never
by deleting the bullet, because a silently deleted belief gets re-proposed.

Beliefs are **not** capital authority. The only capital-actionable artifact is
`{TICKER}/research/human_decision.json` (resolver `_system/scripts/decision_authority.py`).

## Approved beliefs — Charlie Munger

### Mental models & latticework

- Build a latticework of mental models from multiple disciplines before specializing in stock picking; isolated facts without models produce "confusion and folly." — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Munger-1994-Elementary-Worldly-Wisdom.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`

### Inversion & failure avoidance

- Before asking "why is this a good investment," ask "what would make this fail?" and whether we can survive being wrong. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Munger-1994-Elementary-Worldly-Wisdom.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Invert an implausible distribution claim before trusting a data aggregator's share count. When $5.3M of net income appears to fund ~$157M of dividends on 3.46M shares, the share count or the yield is wrong — not the arithmetic. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Psychology of misjudgment

- Maintain a checklist of ~25 standard causes of human misjudgment; watch for **lollapalooza** effects when several biases combine. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Psychology-of-Human-Misjudgment.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Incentive-caused bias is among the most reliable forces in human behavior — always map who gets paid for what before trusting management narrative. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Psychology-of-Human-Misjudgment.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Incentive-caused bias has a repeatable public-markets fingerprint: a **recently internalized manager**, plus an **earnout tied to a self-reported metric** (Adjusted EBITDA), plus a **restatement in that same accounting area**. Track the combination, not any single leg. — `WHK/investor-documents/sec-edgar/424B4_20260609_rpt_acc0001193125_26_264014.htm`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-08-05.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Moats & competitive advantage

- Prefer businesses where rational managers can defend pricing power over long periods; moat quality matters more than near-term EPS noise. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Munger-1994-Elementary-Worldly-Wisdom.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- A moat that has been stable for decades still produces sub-15% returns when price outruns per-share cash growth. Moat quality answers "will it survive," not "what will I earn" — the two questions need separate answers. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Goodwill impairment on acquired software is a signal that management paid for optionality the market no longer credits. Either re-underwrite that optionality inside segment growth, or write its terminal value to zero explicitly — do not leave it implicit in the multiple. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Circle of competence & simplicity

- If we cannot explain the business in plain language within five sentences, we are outside circle of competence — pass or defer. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/munger/Munger-1994-Elementary-Worldly-Wisdom.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`

### Structure before price

- For externally managed vehicles (mortgage REITs, advised trusts), capitalize the manager fee drag as an explicit liability component before comparing price to book. Filing book alone is not a dhando floor. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- For asset-backed financing holdcos, separate filing book equity from the economic overhang of margin loans and prepaid forwards before treating price-to-book as dhando; each pledge is its own proof row. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- For single-segment equipment suppliers with disclosed customer concentration, treat the peak fiscal year as an upper bound and trough operating cash flow as the stress case before any stance above **watch**. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- On illiquid venues (TSE PRO, OTC Pink), treat vendor price feeds as discovery evidence only; confirm a live broker quote before sizing, however attractive the mechanical return looks. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

## Approved beliefs — Mohnish Pabrai

### Dhando & asymmetric payoffs

- Seek **heads I win, tails I don't lose much** — downside protection matters more than upside precision. — Dhando framework; `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/pabrai/` letters 2005–2020 `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Understandable, durable, regulated businesses can still fail the 15% bar at fair bond-proxy multiples. **Watch** is the correct stance absent a price dislocation — quality is never a reason to pay any price. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- A high mechanical IRR computed on filing FCF at a depressed price stays **partial** dhando until the bear case explicitly models an FCF step-down. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- High cash yield backed by oligopoly pricing gives partial dhando only; a binary regulatory outcome prevents **full** dhando at any price implying a high-single-digit IRR or less. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Engineered-in stickiness (auto tier-one, spec-locked components) limits permanent loss, but OEM pricing and the cycle cap upside asymmetry. Bounded downside on its own is not dhando. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Bet sizing & concentration

- Run a concentrated portfolio of high-conviction ideas; redemptions are a feature when partners leave capital with fewer, better ideas. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/pabrai/Pabrai-Letter-l_010112.pdf` (2012) `[active 2026-05-21]`
- When subscriptions lag redemptions but idea quality is high, treat cash scarcity as a signal to prioritize — not to dilute into marginal names. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/pabrai/Pabrai-Letter-l_010124.pdf` (Jan 2024) `[active 2026-05-21]`

### Business selection

- Invest only in simple, understandable businesses with durable economics and honest management — skip complex stories requiring heroic assumptions. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/pabrai/` partner letters 2005–2025 `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Pre-revenue asset plays stay **partial** dhando until an SEC-filed contract defines the downside (a tenant lease, or non-recourse project financing). A resource estimate is not a floor. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-06-17.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Cloning & learning

- Cloning great investors is valid starting point — but every cloned idea still requires independent primary-source verification before capital. — Dhando / Pabrai letter practice `[active 2026-05-21]`

### Valuation heuristics

*(No entries promoted yet — add from future deep dives.)*

### Portfolio discipline

- Wait for fat pitches; annual redemption windows and fund capacity limits are constraints to respect, not obstacles to force trades. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/pabrai/Pabrai-Letter-l_010125.pdf` (Jan 2025) `[active 2026-05-21]`

## Approved beliefs — Murray Stahl

### Croupier business model

- **Croupiers** facilitate pecuniary transactions (exchanges, custodians, processors) without putting principal capital at risk — distinct from balance-sheet financials like banks. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Croupier-Business-Model-2008.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Modern regulation pushes OTC/exotic instruments toward organized exchanges and clearing — expanding croupier TAM over time. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Croupier-Business-Model-2008.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Liquidity demand can **rise** in crises (ETF turnover, futures hedging) even when credit markets freeze — do not assume croupier volumes collapse with recession. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Croupier-Business-Model-2008.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Toll-like contract economics do **not** make a croupier. On-site industrial gas plants, fab equipment, HDD, pipelines and regulated wires all put principal capital and asset risk to work — they are infrastructure or compounder archetypes. The croupier test is the *absence of principal at risk*, not the shape of the revenue. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Archetype assignment

- A ticker onboarded from an 8-K alone, before its 424B4/S-1 is in evidence, must default to archetype `pending`/`unknown`. The machine default `compounder` asserts a reinvestment mechanism the prospectus may not support — WHK read as `compounder` until its 424B4 showed a non-operated royalty toll. — `WHK/investor-documents/sec-edgar/424B4_20260609_rpt_acc0001193125_26_264014.htm`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-08-05.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Exchanges & market infrastructure

- For exchanges, analyze **handled volume** alongside market share — share loss and volume growth are not mutually exclusive. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Exchanges-Less-Talk-More-Figures-2009.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Exchange operating margins can remain extraordinarily high (20–75%+) through severe market stress — durability matters more than one-year EPS dips. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Exchanges-Less-Talk-More-Figures-2009.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Fee model matters: ad valorem pricing ties revenue to market levels; per-trade/volume pricing can be more resilient in drawdowns. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Exchanges-Less-Talk-More-Figures-2009.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- For an exchange croupier trading at peak average daily turnover, size a peak-cycle reserve as an **explicit negative component** before treating spot EPS as a floor; volume mean-reversion is the binding bear case, not a tail. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- LSEG is a croupier: data, index and clearing tolls on a recurring income base — **"Over 70% of our income is recurring in nature and benefits from long-term customer relationships"** (73% of total income including recoveries), at a 50.3% adjusted EBITDA margin in FY2025 — **not organic**: p. 4 carries footnote 4 on that figure, "Includes benefit from the Post Trade Solutions transaction", so it is not comparable to the 48.8% prior year without backing that benefit out. — `LSEG/investor-documents/ir-lseg/annual_report_2025.pdf` (p. 5 "Our investment case" for the >70% and 73% figures; p. 4 "Group highlights" for the margin and its footnote 4) `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Real diversification

- ~50% of S&P 500 names are statistically irrelevant to index performance (≤7 bp weight each); index "diversification" is narrower than it appears. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Achievement-of-Diversification-2020.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Low index weight ≠ low economic importance — compare employees, revenue, and real-economy footprint, not cap-weight alone. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Achievement-of-Diversification-2020.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`
- Where outcomes are near-independent and idiosyncratic failure rates are high (biotech), diversified factor exposure is more coherent than concentrated event bets — base rates beat conviction when internal correlation is low. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-09.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Spinoffs & corporate simplification

- Spinoffs and separations can unlock value when conglomerate complexity hides segment economics — screen for forced simplification events. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/stahl/Stahl-Spinoffs-Going-Separate-Ways-2015.pdf` `[active 2026-05-21]`

### Structural rhymes

- A land-grant checkerboard rhyme is structural, not commodity-identical. A synthetic substitute (soda ash) caps mineral pricing power in a way oil and gas royalties are not capped — do not clone a TPL valuation onto a different mineral because the land pattern matches. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-27.md`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-31.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Long product lifecycle & durability

*(No entries promoted yet — add from future deep dives.)*

## Approved beliefs — Horizon Kinetics

### Equity yield curve & time arbitrage

- When future value and timing are reasonably knowable, institutional 12-month horizons create steep discounts (~35% annualized at ~3 years in HK case studies); patient capital captures **time arbitrage**. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/horizon-kinetics/Stahl-Equity-Yield-Curve-extract.txt` `[active 2026-05-22]`
- A dormant-asset discount is not an equity yield curve without a **filed catalyst date**. Absent a disclosed transaction, the curve is an analyst assumption dressed as a schedule. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- A dated strategic-alternatives process is what converts a dormant-asset discount into a plottable curve; dormancy on its own is not a catalyst. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-06-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Predictive attributes

- Index screeners use **descriptive** (backward-looking) attributes; forward **predictive** predispositions — dormant assets, dated recovery, NPI deficit paydown — are more useful for prospective returns. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/horizon-kinetics/HK-Q1-2025-Commentary-extract.txt` `[active 2026-05-22]`

### Market structure discounts

- Royalty trusts, K-1 LPs, and yield-screen exclusions can persistently misprice otherwise debt-free, high-margin pass-through securities. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/horizon-kinetics/HK-Q1-2026-Commentary-extract.txt` `[active 2026-05-22]`
- In non-reporting OTC limited partnerships, GAAP book can understate a royalty franchise by multiples, because land and reserves sit at historical cost. Price-to-book is not the market-structure test — the franchise cash flow is. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-06-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
  - The BVERS price pair originally carried here (~$595 book against ~$2,400) was removed 2026-08-09: the cited daily log labels the $2,400 an `[Assumption]`, not a quote, so promoting it both froze a dated number in a belief and contradicted the illiquid-venue rule above (`On illiquid venues (TSE PRO, OTC Pink), treat vendor price feeds as discovery evidence only`). — `_system/memory/daily/2026-06-10.md`; `BVERS/research/deep_dive_2026-06-10.md`
- A market structure discount (no 10-K, thin OTC quote) can hide land-heavy or royalty economics, but **minority realization** through nonprofit or family-controlled governance is the binding constraint — the discount may be entirely correct. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-06-10.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Scarce assets

- For scarce-asset land owners with off-balance-sheet legacy estates, compare price to the proof-first component sum and to Lawrence owner cash — not to GAAP book. A premium over the component base embeds milestone timing and scarcity; it is not evidence of a filing error. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Transitory problems

- Temporary dividend suspension from recoverable operator charges (Mesabi, SJT, HE) can be an equity yield curve setup when deficit and timeline are bounded — but capex overruns extend the curve. — `_system/reference/investment-wisdom/horizon-kinetics/HK-Q1-2025-Commentary-extract.txt` `[active 2026-05-22]`

**Catalog:** `_system/frameworks/mental_models.md`

## Approved beliefs — MOI (Manual of Ideas)

*Section opened 2026-08-09. Lens tag: `[PROPOSED MOI]`. Framework:
`_system/frameworks/moi_company_evaluation.md`; idea funnel and `payoff_lens` in
`_system/frameworks/decision_stack.md`.*

### Normalize before you claim a floor

- Trailing FCF near zero during a capex cycle is a **trough illustration**, not an owner-cash floor. Normalize the cycle before stance, and exclude warrant and mark-to-market gains from owner cash. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-18.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Under milestone billing, operating cash flow can run ahead of GAAP earnings quality during a backlog build. Normalize before stance rather than reading the cash conversion as durable. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-18.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### What is not net asset value

- A PEA net present value is not equity NAV for a pre-reserve developer until probability of permitting and financing, and expected dilution, are haircut out. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-18.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- RPO or backlog per share is not NAV. Levered equity written against a backlog requires an interest-cost and customer-concentration stress before any per-share claim. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-18.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Where the inefficiency actually is

- The classic S&P 500 index-inclusion premium fell to ~0.8% in the 2010s (Greenwood & Sammon 2022). The residual edge is in *anticipating* membership changes and in smaller, less-liquid, less-substitutable names with steeper demand curves (Wurgler & Zhuravskaya; Petajisto). Rank index alerts by demand shock versus ADV and calendar proximity — never by the mere fact of a change. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-01.md`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-09.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- In biotech, traditional P/E and own-price momentum are inverted signals; use spend-based value and clinical peer momentum instead, and treat multi-specialist ownership (>50% of biotech funds) as the primary public quality screen. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-09.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- When ranking specialist 13F names, separate **issuer** size (where the small-cap edge lives) from **position** liquidity. A diversified short book is high short interest × weak consensus — a single high-SI name is never a conviction short. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-09.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

## Approved beliefs — process & pipeline (GENERIC)

*Section opened 2026-08-09. Lens tag: `[PROPOSED GENERIC]`. Pipeline **errors** belong in
`_system/memory/corrections.md`; this section holds standing rules about how the system is
allowed to speak.*

### Valuation authority

- The authority chain is: Power Zone route → proof-first universal contract → Investment Committee → `{TICKER}/research/human_decision.json`. Resolver: `_system/scripts/decision_authority.py`. Only the human decision is capital-actionable. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Marvin/Lawrence `implied_return`, `stance_proposal` and classification Thesis IRR are **legacy reference** — a specialist cross-check inside a fitting Power Zone at most. Never call them house IRR. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- World Model / Magis / Santa Fe are claim and context layers. They must not rewrite contracts, IC packets, or human decisions, and the two valuation languages must not be mixed. — `_system/frameworks/proof_first_valuation.md`; `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Do not merge foresight (World Model) and complexity economics (Santa Fe) into one simulator. Gate what agents and the morning strip may assert with a thin `predictability_class` (P0–P4). — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-24.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- Dashboard context series — the BTC demand power-law is the live example — are context-only, and must not enter a Lawrence base IRR without human review. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-08-04.md`; `dashboard/data/hk_snowball_model.json` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

### Pipeline order of operations

- After an SEC download for scaffolded names, rebuild `INDEX.csv` **before** `build_filing_evidence` — a stale INDEX yields `docs=0` with no error. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-28.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`
- CI roles: the Data Pipeline workflow is the scheduled writer, Darwin is manual-only, and deploy is deploy-only — it runs after upstream commits land and never rebuilds. — `_system/memory/daily/2026-07-12.md` `[active 2026-08-09 · agent]`

## Approved beliefs — company-specific

Company facts age fastest, so every row carries a status and the date it was last checked
against its cited source. Add ` · agent` to the status when an agent, not the human, made
that check — the same marker the belief bullets carry, and for the same reason: a status
date with no marker reads as a human affirmation.

Most sources here are filings. A row sourced to a **deep dive** is a judgement, not a fact
